'''Hellhounds''' can be found on the [[occult floors]] while [[Dungeoneering]]. They have a high attack and strength, but usually lower defence. The higher level ones have a much higher defence and can hit in the high 200's and low to mid 300's. They share the same weakness to slashing weapons as their cousins outside of [[Daemonheim]].
